# Trust — four answers

## State of evidence

- Trust can rest on the price of an action instead of on identity — [[Sources/2026-01-10_aaaaaaaa/source#Alpha paper]].
- A ladder of rights is the other answer:
  > "Beta is a bookmark-tier capture about trust and quotas." — [[Sources/2026-02-11_bbbbbbbb/source]]
- The incident report is navigation only ([[Sources/2026-03-12_cccccccc-2/extract|Gamma v2]]): no locator, so the revision stays uncited.

## Contradictions

| Position | Holds when |
|---|---|
| price of action | the action is costly to fake |
| quotas and karma | the channel can remember the actor |

## Open questions

- Are these answers to one question?

## Atlas reading

2026-10-22 — the agent's position: the two answers are complementary, not rival. Mentions trust here too, which a snippet must not show.
